attributes.title: 135th Annual MVMA Convention
attributes.summary:
The Missouri Veterinary Medical Association holds its 135th Annual Convention January 28 to 31, 2027 in Columbia, Missouri. The convention is the state association's yearly meeting and gives Missouri veterinarians a chance to earn CE in their home state.

When we checked, exhibitor registration was open. The association said attendee registration and further details would follow in the fall.

The venue, program tracks, fees and CE hours were not posted yet. Check the convention site before you plan your hours for the renewal cycle.
